d:
"Bombhaat" video from the movie "Lie" is a high-energy track featuring Nithiin and Megha Akash. Composed by Mani Sharma and sung by Rahul Sipligunj and Ramya Behara, this song is a perfect blend of beats and grooves. Enjoy the music!
Song Name : Bombhaat
Movie Name : Lie
Editor : S.R. Shekhar,
Art : S.Ravinder
Music : Mani Sharma
Casting: Nithiin, Megha Akash
Lyrics: Kasarla Shyam
